name: Discovery mode / 3-step trend
thesis: When value breaks with acceptance + real aggression, price trends; the retest into the low-volume node is the low-risk entry. Likely lower WR / higher RR - test anyway.
rules: Profile a clear directional move; mark the low-volume node with the strongest delta. Wait for a retest where the counter side gets absorbed, enter on aggression with follow-through. Stop beyond the absorbed lows; trail or target the prior session POC.
